node.title: Re: Blocking Inappropriate Content on Contact Form
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
How is the spammer getting by my safeguards?

You'd need to post the actual, [id://11118322|raw data] you're receiving in order for us to be able to tell, along with code ([id://1177642|SSCCE]). Perhaps they're using some Unicode characters (that don't survive your copy&paste)? See all the advice you got in your last thread [id://11145339].
